title: OrderCreated v1
description: Value of records on qa.orders.v1. Record key = orderId. Headers: correlation-id, event-type, schema-version. Enforced at runtime by node-red/lib/order-event.js (no schema library is used).

correlationId.description: From the X-Correlation-Id header or body.correlationId, else a generated UUID.

$comment: Downstream OrderProcessed (qa.orders.processed.v1) = { schemaVersion, eventType:'OrderProcessed', correlationId, sourceEventId, orderId, customerId, currency, itemCount (sum of quantity), totalAmount (sum of quantity*unitPrice, 2 dp), status:'PROCESSED', source:{topic,partition,offset}, processedAt }. Rejected records go to qa.orders.dlq.v1 as OrderRejected { reason: INVALID_JSON | SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED, errors[], correlationId|null, source, rawValue, rejectedAt }.
